technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals (three white soldiers, RSI14 rising, supertrend) offset by weak trend structure (below 50-day MAs, below Ichimoku cloud, low ADX) and overbought oscillators; moderate confluence with elevated risk.

fundamental.summary: WYNN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 70 days.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — moderate amounts, junior-to-mid tier members
sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 12) presents contrarian buy opportunity; modest congressional buying by Lee (Jan 2022) supports bullish setup, but stale data and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (361), flat yield curve signals recession risk, and Consumer Discretionary sector faces demand destruction; 70-day earnings window adds execution risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + RSI14 bullish + supertrend bullish with extreme fear contrarian signal (VIX 361) creates a classic capitulation reversal setup near support (62.67).
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, recession risk), price below both 50-day MAs and Ichimoku cloud, zero fundamental conviction (no insider buying, weak smart money), overbought oscillators, and 70-day earnings risk make this a high-risk fade of a weak trend structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Three white soldiers + RSI14 bullish + supertrend bullish create technical reversal setup at support (62.67) with extreme fear contrarian signal (VIX 361). However, severe macro headwinds, zero fundamental conviction, and overbought oscillators override the setup.
